Help

Tip: in “Explain buttons” mode, tap any button, tab or setting to read what it does without using it.

Dashboard – your home page: today’s words, your stories, books (folders), journal, characters and idea boards. Tap Dashboard any time to come back.

Library – on the left. Add stories and folders, rename, delete, reorder with ▲ ▼, filter by category, and read a whole folder as a book. Switch to Journal for your private diary.

Writing page – the ribbon has Home (fonts, colors, lists), Insert (pictures, tables, symbols), Layout (spacing, paper, width) and View (focus mode, read as a book).

Side panel – Focus (clock, Pomodoro, word goal), Music (your songs, moods, ambient sounds), Cast (characters), Check (repeated words, name spelling), Words (dictionary, glossary), Ideas, Daily and Settings.

Pin board – sticky notes and pictures you can move, tie together with string and sort onto boards.

Export / Print – save as Word, ePub, PDF, a web page or text, or print as a book.

Install – on Android or Windows use your browser’s Install app option. On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

Settings – pick a design, dim the screen, change scenes and turn game mode on or off.
